newsitem.title: USA: Group holds 5.22 pct of Princeton National.
newsitem.headline: Group holds 5.22 pct of Princeton National.

text.p: A group of Chicago-based funds and partnerships controlled by investment manager Charles Moore said Friday that it acquired 149,249 shares of Princeton National Bancorp Inc., or 5.22 percent of the total.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it acquired the stake for investment purposes.
The group said it bought 46,000 of the shares between April 22 and 30 at prices ranging from $18.49 to $18.56 each.
